title: Oxide joins Anthropic’s Project Glasswing to test critical infrastructure code
friendlyTitle: Oxide will use Claude to test its infrastructure software
summary: Oxide says it is joining Anthropic’s Project Glasswing and will apply Claude Mythos 5 across its open-source infrastructure stack, including firmware, operating-system, control-plane and network code. The company says it intends to identify and patch vulnerabilities while sharing security work openly.
friendlySummary: Oxide plans to use Claude Mythos 5 to look for security problems across firmware, operating systems and networking code.
whyItMatters: This is a practical test of advanced security agents across code that spans hardware and software boundaries, rather than a narrow benchmark. Open code and published fixes can make the claimed benefits easier for customers and researchers to inspect.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may help find difficult bugs in important systems. Open code and public fixes make it easier for others to check the work.
